info.title: aiball bus subjects
info.description: bus.subscribe gives a subject's value, then bus.event notifications with each change as data. See docs/API-BUS.md.

value.name: value
value.summary: { project, backlog: [{ id, tier, cooled_until }] }: the agent's backlog as the picker sees it

event.name: event
event.summary: { project, changed: [ids] }: the tickets whose place changed (sunk by a wake, out of their rest, another tier, in or out)

id.description: an id, or * for all (those added later too)

value.name: value
value.summary: the agent's bar, as consumer.bar gives it, or null; with *, keyed by agent

event.name: event
event.summary: the bar, whenever it changes or goes stale

event.name: event
event.summary: `{ event, data }`: `ping` (the ping, outside the wake focus not sent), `control` (`kill`, `prompt`, `restart_claude`), `signal`, or `counters` (the agent's counters, when a number changed)

value.name: value
value.summary: `{ source }`: where the screen comes from, `host`, `tmux` or `node`; null when it cannot be followed (an `unavailable` event says why)

event.name: event
event.summary: `snapshot` / `output` (the session host: base64 bytes to write to a terminal, a snapshot after a reset), `size` (the host's size), `frame` (tmux or a node: the whole screen as text, with `cursor` and `geometry`), `error` (passing), `unavailable` (nothing more comes)

id.description: an id, or * for all (those added later too)

value.name: value
value.summary: the agent's entry, as consumer.list gives it; with *, keyed by agent

event.name: event
event.summary: the whole entry again whenever it changed; null once the consumer is deleted

value.name: value
value.summary: null: the feed has no state of its own

event.name: event
event.summary: `{ op: "set" | "clear", key, project, value, by }`, or `{ op: "reload" }` after a config file was reloaded

id.description: an id, or * for all (those added later too)

value.name: value
value.summary: the loop as loop.list shows it, or null; with *, keyed by loop name

event.name: event
event.summary: the whole view again whenever it changed; null once the loop is forgotten (rm)

id.description: an id, or * for all (those added later too)

value.name: value
value.summary: the rows inbox.list gives with view: turn (options open, include_postponed); with *, keyed by project

event.name: event
event.summary: { op: upsert, row } or { op: remove, id, project }; a row is pushed when it changed, time-derived fields included

id.description: an id, or * for all (those added later too)

value.name: value
value.summary: a session without an agent, as session.list gives it, or null; with *, keyed by name

event.name: event
event.summary: { name, session }: started, clients, exited; session null once stopped

value.name: value
value.summary: what ticket.get gives with full: true

event.name: event
event.summary: { type, message }: a message created, edited, decided, noted or tagged on the ticket

event.name: event
event.summary: a ping, and message: what it points at (kind, status, author, project, ticket title, decision)
